source.label: Artificial Analysis open-model index (family discovery)
source.methodology: Official model cards provide architecture, parameter, context and license. Artificial Analysis is used only to discover families; hosted TPS, price and intelligence are not local-hardware evidence. Local KV is Q8 unless an AI Fusion Turbo variant is selected (K8/Q3 KV, ~5GB weights in RAM, ~1GB KV on SSD, 5% safety).
source.license: Mixed: Apache 2.0, MIT, Llama Community licenses and other model-specific terms

data.name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
data.notes: Compact local baseline for light assistant and extraction workloads.

data.name: Qwen3 8B
data.notes: Dense Qwen3 successor to the 7B-class local slot, with thinking and non-thinking modes. Specs, 32,768-token native context (YaRN to 131,072) and Apache 2.0 license: official Qwen/Qwen3-8B model card. KV cache bytes/token derived from official GQA (36 layers, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128) and quantized to Q8 for local planning (1 byte per K/V element). Fit is calculated from weights plus configured KV/runtime/safety overhead; it does not verify runtime compatibility or TPS. Long context can require substantially more memory than the weight estimate.

data.name: Qwen3 14B
data.notes: Dense Qwen3 local planning model with thinking and non-thinking modes. Specs, 32,768-token native context (YaRN to 131,072) and Apache 2.0 license: official Qwen/Qwen3-14B model card. KV cache bytes/token derived from official GQA (40 layers, 8 KV heads, head_dim 128) and quantized to Q8 for local planning (1 byte per K/V element). Fit is calculated from weights plus configured KV/runtime/safety overhead; it does not verify runtime compatibility or TPS. Long context can require substantially more memory than the weight estimate.

data.name: Llama 3.1 70B Instruct
data.notes: Large local model for advanced reasoning and RAG planning scenarios.

data.name: Qwen3.5 9B
data.notes: Current compact multimodal and reasoning option. Specs and Apache 2.0 license: official Qwen/Qwen3.5-9B model card. Fit is calculated from weights plus configured KV/runtime/safety overhead; it does not verify runtime compatibility or TPS. Long context can require substantially more memory than the weight estimate.

data.name: Gemma 4 12B IT
data.notes: Multimodal Gemma 4 workstation model. Specs and Apache 2.0 license: official Google Gemma 4 model card. Fit is calculated from weights plus configured KV/runtime/safety overhead; it does not verify runtime compatibility or TPS. Audio support depends on the selected checkpoint and runtime.

data.name: Phi-4 14B
data.notes: Compact reasoning-focused dense model. Specs and MIT license: official microsoft/phi-4 model card. Fit is calculated from weights plus configured KV/runtime/safety overhead; it does not verify runtime compatibility or TPS.

data.name: gpt-oss-20b
data.notes: Officially released in native MXFP4 and described by OpenAI as runnable within 16GB memory. Specs and Apache 2.0 license: OpenAI gpt-oss model card. Calculator fit adds conservative KV/runtime/safety overhead, so its recommended capacity can exceed the publisher's minimum. No local TPS is assumed.

data.name: Mistral Small 3.1 24B Instruct
data.notes: Mainstream multimodal local model; Mistral documents quantized deployment on one RTX 4090 or a 32GB-memory MacBook. Specs and Apache 2.0 license: official Mistral model card. Fit is calculated from weights plus configured KV/runtime/safety overhead; it does not verify runtime compatibility or TPS.

data.name: Qwen3.8 27B
data.notes: Dense Qwen3.8 vision-language model with hybrid Gated DeltaNet / gated attention. Specs, native 262,144-token context (YaRN to 1M) and Apache 2.0 license: official Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B model card. Fit is calculated from weights plus configured KV/runtime/safety overhead; it does not verify runtime compatibility or TPS. Long context can require substantially more memory than the weight estimate.

data.name: Gemma 4 26B A4B IT
data.notes: Gemma 4 MoE workstation model (3.8B active / 25.2B total). Local KV is Q8. AI Fusion Turbo is catalogued separately. Does not verify runtime or TPS.

data.name: Gemma 4 26B A4B IT · AI Fusion Turbo
data.notes: AI Fusion Turbo planning variant of Gemma 4 26B A4B IT. Same weights; K 8-bit, Q 3-bit KV (67,584 B/token); ~5GB RAM offload, ~1GB SSD KV, 5% safety. Does not verify runtime, offload path or TPS.

data.name: Gemma 4 31B IT
data.notes: Largest dense Gemma 4 workstation option. Specs and Apache 2.0 license: official google/gemma-4-31B model card. Fit is calculated from weights plus configured KV/runtime/safety overhead; it does not verify runtime compatibility or TPS.

data.name: MiniMax H3 33B
data.notes: Omni-modal audio-video generator, not an LLM. Official H3-Omni-Transformer is a 33B dense model; about 13B AdaLN parameters can be cached at inference, but this catalog keeps dense active=total so fit uses the full 33B weights. Publisher does not document an LLM context window; 8192 is only a packed-sequence planning bound for the schema. License: MiniMax H3 Community License. Token TPS/TTFT economics do not apply. Runtime, quality and memory must be validated on the intended FL2VA or Ref2VA checkpoint.

data.name: Qwen3.6 35B A3B
data.notes: Qwen3.6 35B MoE (~3B active). Local KV is Q8. AI Fusion Turbo is catalogued separately. Does not verify runtime or TPS.

data.name: Qwen3.6 35B A3B · AI Fusion Turbo
data.notes: AI Fusion Turbo planning variant of Qwen3.6 35B A3B. Same weights; K 8-bit, Q 3-bit KV (90,112 B/token); ~5GB RAM offload, ~1GB SSD KV, 5% safety. Does not verify runtime, offload path or TPS.

data.name: Ornith 1.5 35B A3B
data.notes: Ornith 1.5 35B MoE (~3B active, 262K context). Local KV is Q8. AI Fusion Turbo is catalogued separately. Does not verify runtime or TPS.

data.name: Ornith 1.5 35B A3B · AI Fusion Turbo
data.notes: AI Fusion Turbo planning variant of Ornith 1.5 35B A3B. Same weights; K 8-bit, Q 3-bit KV (90,112 B/token); ~5GB RAM offload, ~1GB SSD KV, 5% safety. Does not verify runtime, offload path or TPS.

data.name: Llama 4 Scout 17B-16E Instruct
data.notes: Multimodal MoE with 109B total and 17B active parameters. Specs and license conditions: official Meta Llama 4 Scout model card. Commercial use is marked restricted because the custom Llama 4 Community License includes conditions. Fit uses total weights plus configured overhead; the 10M maximum context is not a promise that full context fits local memory, and runtime/TPS remain unverified.

data.name: gpt-oss-120b
data.notes: Officially released in native MXFP4 and described by OpenAI as runnable on a single 80GB GPU. Specs and Apache 2.0 license: OpenAI gpt-oss model card. Calculator fit adds configured KV/runtime/safety overhead and therefore targets a 96GB-class envelope at moderate context; no local TPS is assumed.

data.name: Qwen3.8 Flash Next
data.notes: Qwen4-preview multimodal MoE: 125B backbone with 6B activated per token, plus a 51B n-gram embedding table and 4B MTP head that the publisher describes as offloadable. Specs, native 262,144-token context (YaRN to 1M) and qwen-community-1.0 license: official Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next model card. Fit uses the 125B MoE backbone, not the offloaded n-gram table; add that capacity if it stays on the accelerator. Runtime, quality and TPS must be validated.

data.name: DeepSeek-V4-Flash
data.notes: DeepSeek-V4-Flash MoE: 284B total / 13B active, 1M native context. Official instruct checkpoint stores MoE experts in FP4 and most other weights in FP8. Specs and MIT license: official deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash model card. Fit uses total weights plus configured overhead; the 1M window is not a promise that full context fits local memory. Runtime, quality and TPS must be validated. Think Max mode is documented as needing at least a 384K working window.
